title: Defeater-search saturation requires search, not absence

model.search_log: ordered adversarial rounds with strategy family and newly discovered defeater classes
model.trailing_zero_novel_rounds: consecutive most-recent rounds finding no new class
model.strategy_diversity: number of distinct declared adversarial strategy families
model.novelty_upper_bound: HF-SIM-014 zero-discovery Bernoulli surrogate applied only to the trailing zero-novelty run

rules: Zero recorded defeaters without a search log is not saturation.
Repeated rounds from only one strategy family do not satisfy a declared diversity requirement.
A newly discovered defeater resets the trailing zero-novelty streak.
Meeting the stopping surrogate permits pausing search; it does not prove completeness.
invariants: No Defeaters Recorded != No Defeaters Exist
Adversarial search diversity is distinct from search volume
boundary: The strategy-family labels and Bernoulli-like stopping surrogate are research-control metadata, not validated estimates of real unknown-failure probability.
